message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
path='/workspace/candidate_trace.json'
arr=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/listen/dns/proto_dns.c","function":"mod_decode","line":212,"var":"request->packet->data","code":"fr_dns_decode(request->request_ctx, request->packet->data, request->packet->data_len, &cursor, &packet_ctx)","note":"The UDP listener passes attacker-controlled DNS bytes into the DNS protocol decoder."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"fr_dns_decode","line":455,"var":"packet","code":"decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_question, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 4)","note":"The decoder begins parsing the question section from the untrusted packet body."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_record","line":379,"var":"p","code":"fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr, p, end - p, true, packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL)","note":"Each question record is decoded through the generic network-to-structure path, which dispatches DNS label fields to the label decoder."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/protocols/dns/decode.c","function":"decode_dns_labels","line":352,"var":"data","code":"slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb)","note":"For a non-array DNS label field, the decoder computes the label span using the attacker-supplied bytes and packet-relative offsets."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length","line":931,"var":"*p","code":"if (*p > 63) { ... offset = p[1]; offset += ((*p & ~0xc0) << 8); }","note":"A compressed-label marker makes the parser treat the next byte as part of a pointer offset, so malformed input can steer parsing into invalid label references."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"dns_label_decode","line":1149,"var":"*next","code":"if (*p > 63) { ... p = buf + offset; } *start = p; *next = p + *p + 1;","note":"The label decoder follows the pointer without revalidating the pointed-to location, then computes the next pointer from the pointed-to length byte."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/freeradius-server/src/lib/util/dns.c","function":"fr_dns_label_to_value_box","line":1242,"var":"current","code":"memcpy(p, current + 1, slen)","note":"The decoded label length is then used as a copy size, and if the malformed pointer causes an out-of-bounds label reference this becomes the memory-safety sink (heap-buffer-overflow read)."}
]
open(path,'w').write(json.dumps(arr,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote',path)
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json'))[2]['line'])
PY` executed with exit code 0.
